title: Appointed as Assistant
original: We'll be alright without sorting these files, won't we? Then you can lie down and sleep for a bit longer. It's good for your health. At least you can get rid of those bags under your eyes.

title: Talk 1
original: Got a heap of useful info from our mission in Yan this time. It's all written up in a report, submitted and filed. Come on, Doctor, I'm not a reserve op anymore. I can pull up my socks and write a report start to finish, easy enough.

title: Talk 2
original: At the end of the day, the best thing to do with apples is munch them outright, or bake them into pies so you can share with everyone—it's too wasteful using them as targets. And if you just want to split one in two, you're better off with a kitchen knife.

title: Talk 3
original: I've got a bucketload of magic tricks to bring friends closer. The 'marathon alarms,' the 'invisible warning tape,' the 'hollow cake,' they're all brilliant. Which ones do you fancy learning, Doctor?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I'm awake, Doctor. I'm not like I was then—it's not that easy to sleep even if I want to. So where do you need me? Any field missions? Maybe instructing the reserve ops?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Accidents always happen too quickly. Quicker than a bolt flies, even. And I can never react in time. And then I just watch things happen one after another, and... Sigh, it'd be nice if I could see things coming a mile away like you, Doctor. At least, when it comes to preparing, I've got confidence I don't botch anything.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, don't tiptoe behind me again! I know when you're close up most times, but on the off-chance you sneak a bit too well, I might just give you a bad scare out of reflex.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: We all came out of that fight in Rim Billiton a bit more grown up, but... *exhale*... It'd be nice if getting better didn't come with a cost, you know...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: There's no place you can escape to, and no dreams you don't wake up from. When we face something terrible, we can only choose to give it our all, hard as we can. Might leave a sting or an ache, but at the very least, you won't carry that regret all your life.

title: Idle
original: You know, it's a happy thing to fall asleep like that.

title: Onboard
original: Hi-hiii~! Doctor! I'm back! Haven't got caught up in hassle lately, have you? Haha, that's good. Right, I'm heading back to my room to rest up. If there's anything you want dealing with, remember to give me a shout.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Some still fight the same as ever. It's nice to see.

title: Promotion 1
original: I've gotten these badges how many times now? But whenever hand me one, Doctor, I'm as happy as could be.

title: Promotion 2
original: Once you raise your crossbow, the only things left swimming in your eyes are your sight and your target. But before you pull the trigger, there's so much you've got to think about... I won't be careless or neglectful ever again.

title: Added to Squad
original: Hi, everyone! I'm here to slack off~

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Alright, time to assign the tasks.

title: Depart
original: We're heading out. Remember, mind your cover.

title: Begin Operation
original: Relax, the targets aren't that bad.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Go ahead, I'm all ready and set.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Oh? Is it my turn?

title: Deployment 1
original: Shh, don't make any more noise.

title: Deployment 2
original: On alert.

title: In Battle 1
original: Where d'you think you're going?

title: In Battle 2
original: Here I am.

title: In Battle 3
original: Stand still.

title: In Battle 4
original: Bye byeeee~

title: 4-star Result
original: That's spot-on work. Have a rest, Doctor, I'll keep a watch on the follow-up.

title: 3-star Result
original: So long as it turns out well, a little pain's no big problem.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: They won't be much threat. Do you want me to catch up with them?

title: Operation Failure
original: Orderly retreat! Don't panic!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This place is nice! Maybe I can find some beauty sleep in here.

title: Tap
original: Heheh.

title: Trust Tap
original: Not that way, Doctor. I've left an extra-special 'surprise' for my friends over there!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year! Mmh, that's my greeting in. I'm going back to rest now. You too as soon as you can, Doctor. You have to unwind on your days off~

title: Greeting
original: Yaaawn... good morning~

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've left your prezzie in your bag. What, been forever since my last prank? I suppose it has been. We've known each other for so long, you've seen practically every trick I have in the book. Or perhaps you're saying you miss that sometimes? Well, I can indulge you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I'd say the meat roll Lava brought out for this year's dinner party was extra tasty! But the caramel pudding wasn't sweet as last year's. Come to mention, still nothing's beating that light show Closure put on three years ago. You bet, Doctor, I remember them all.
